reviews.x: Absolutely love it! I'm a licensed Cosmetologist and so I use round brushes on a daily basis. My salon is filled with Cruelty Free products and tools. The most difficult to find... Tools. Most of the round brushes I've come across are Boar Bristles and I do not support! The cork handle stays cool unlike other round brush handles made of plastic and other materials.

Light weight and easy to hold. Bought this brush few weeks ago and I am very satisfied from it. Affordable, high quality and the handle is very light and comfortable to hold! Happy to say that I use my blow dry every day to straighten my hair and most brushes make my hair look fizzy but this one does not make my hair fizzy at all! I'm giving this one 5 stars since I have been looking for brush like this for a while!

This brush is fantastic. Not only is it super light weight, but it packs a punch when using to blow out my hair. The volume it gives is unlike anything I ever was able to get using a boar bristled brush. It helps this is vegan and good for the environment as well. The bristles are soft and the handle is great to hold and the best part is it doesn't get super hot that it burns if it touches your ear/face while blowing out. I would highly recommend this brush to anyone!

I have been a Hairdresser for 15+ years & I love Big, Sexy Blowouts !! This is by far the best round brush I have ever owned!! Hands Down 110% I’m so happy with this purchase, Also this is the first product review I’ve ever written lol I’m lazy when it comes to feedback but I had to let everyone know how awesome this round brush is!!!

reviews.t: Did not work for me personally, I did not like it. But might work for you!
reviews.x: Not for me. As a stylist, I personally love boar round brushes but wanted a friendly alternative. I don’t like the bristles on this brush they are very scratchy to the touch.  I bought this for personal use and I found that it’s good at stretching out the hair for super straight and smooth blowouts but it went through my hair horribly (personally). I used it on my mom’s hair and it worked perfectly, smoothed out her hair and gave nice curls (we have different hair types). Works great on straight

I ordered this hair brush last week and i absolutely love it! It's the most professional brush i have ever owned. I get amazing results quick, saving me lots of time. Also, the design is very easy and comfortable, i love the grip. The brush does not rip out my hair or scratch my scalp like other brushes i tried before. My hair stays straight and smooth for days without re-straightening it. I have tried lots of brushes and this one is the best by far. I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: The only round brush you will need!
reviews.x: The round brush is perfect for sleek blowouts! I love how it can take the most frizzy hair and transform it to silk! Such a great buy and I love using the hair serum for an extra touch of shine at the end of every style! Would rate the brush 10/10 great sturdy quality, strong Brissles and perfect for achieving the perfect blowout!
Love this brush and everything about it! The design is so cute and unique. Leaves my hair feeling soft and looking great. Definitely recommend.

I like the handle because I have long hair that the other rubber handles catch while drying. Unfortunately the bristles on this brush only get a very thin layer on the top of my hair so it doesn’t actually brush my hair (I guess that’s how it’s considered volume?). If it had at least a few of the detangling bristles spread throughout it could be better. I have previously thick but now thinning hair - maybe this would work for very  fine hair.

[[VIDEOID:db334366b5d41944cbf787b877eb794c]] I bought this product relying on the great reviews, but this is horrible! I usually Divide my hair in small parts to blow dry it and straighten it without the flat iron, but as soon as I started it to blow hot air the bristles burned along with my hair. I don’t know what kind of plastic this is made off but don’t waste your money and damage your hair with this poor quality brush.

I am an avid blow dryer user who is always on the hunt for a better hair brush. I love that the bristles on this brush are a mix of both boar and nylon, which helped leave my hair looking smooth and shiny. I don’t know what it is about this brush, but man does it volumize my hair! I have absolutely no need for hairspray or any hair volumizing pomades when I use this brush. The cork handle is absolutely genius. I use a thermal spray before blow drying, which tends to make my hands very slippery.

reviews.t: Not good for blow drying curly, thick hair
reviews.x: I have curly, thick hair that is about shoulder length. I bought this brush as a replacement for a metal barrel round brush to avoid some heat damage to my hair. Unfortunately, it was impossible to blow dry my curly hair with this brush, no matter how large or small the sections of hair were. It would grab and not release my hair, causing it to pull A LOT before sliding down my hair. I would not recommend this brush for those with curly or thick hair that they blow dry.

reviews.t: Finally!!  The Right Hairbrush for Fine Hair
reviews.x: I've purchased five hairbrushes in the past two years, trying to find one that was right for blow-drying my medium-length fine hair.  This one is PERFECT.  The bristles are stiff enough to hold on, but soft enough to avoid tangling and tearing my hair.  I like that the cork handle does not grab onto my hair.
Very nice to blow dry With but I  Got it yesterday , started blow drying my client today and it’s already losing bristle.

This round brush works perfectly on type 4b/4c natural hair. I wanted to practice blowouts and observed some techniques from Kelly Wxxd on Instagram and YouTube.  I'm still practicing but, with high speed high heat on my hair dryer (I have the conair silver bird) and using tention with this brush I was able to create sleek curls without a flat iron or curling iron.  I noticed the sections of hair need to be very damp to get smooth results. I used kenra smoothing blowout lotion and OGX protecting

reviews.t: Not satisfied. Not good quality, and doesn’t fulfill its purpose.
reviews.x: This is definitely not for those with long thick hair. The bristle don’t brush all the hair, but a very thin layer. The material is very cheap quality, almost like if you were to purchase a toilet scrubber. It seems the bristle are similar quality to a toilet scrubber, but even weaker.  Definitely not satisfied with the purchase as I don’t use the brush anymore; perhaps I will use it for cleaning instead. I like the idea that it is eco friendly, but honestly, unless you have very thin hair, I do

reviews.t: Works great to volumize and add shine
reviews.x: This vegan alternative to a boar bristle brush does a great job volumizing unwashed hair, as well as volumizing and taming freshly washed hair (and does indeed work well for blow drying).  The only con for me isn't really a con: the white bristles show dirt easily (immediately from unwashed hair, but for the health of my hair I often go over a week in the winter, so it would be expected). Even so, it just motivates me to wash it more frequently, ergo keeping it clean and sanitary.

The cork handle confused me at first, but now I realize it is perfect for my sweaty hands, is lightweight, and won’t get hot. The bristles work exactly like boar bristles do for me (which is a good thing). My hair is fine but I have a ton of it and it takes forever to dry, so the density of the bristles helps separate my strands in such a way that it majorly shortens blow drying time.

I love the handle, the easy grip and the light weight brush but the brush does not grip my hair.  My hair isn't thick and I was surprised by the reviews that it wouldn't grip my hair.  i did like it when I first picked it up and was so hoping that it would be THE brush for me as I have had much difficulty finding just the right brush.  On to the next brush.

reviews.t: I wish I read all the reviews...
reviews.x: this is definitely not for thick wavy hair. I can not for the life of me use this to dry my hair with. it tangles up in my main. i do not have long hair, about shoulder length, I had to switch back to the thermal brush. it is easy to hold, but a pain to manage my hair with it during drying.

reviews.t: Comfortable handle & styles my hair perfectly!
reviews.x: This brush has worked so well on my hair. When I blow it out it definitely add volume and makes it shine. Also, I love the cork handle - its very comfortable to hold especially when I'm styling for long periods of time! If you want a salon-grade brush - this one is it.

reviews.t: Love the feeling but it broke in less than 1month
reviews.x: Hmmmm I absolutely wanted to Loved this brush..,but after only 3 weeks the handle broke from the head! And during these ”covid19” times I have only used the to straighten met hear 1x during the 3 weeks I owned this brush :( . Sucks!

reviews.t: You wouldn’t be disappointed when buying this brush!!
reviews.x: Bought this hairbrush for my granddaughter Angela for Christmas!! Well she is sooo happy with her brush. She was looking for one that didn’t pull her hair too much!! I’m happy I was able to find it in Amazon. com

reviews.t: Can finally get a smooth pony!
reviews.x: I love this hairbrush. With waist length curly hair round brushes can be a horror story but this brush is a dream. The bristles are very stiff and smoothing and the handle is very lightweight and comfortable.
This is the best round brush that I ever had and I had quite a few. I have very very very frizzy hair but with this brush I can keep it under control for at list a day even more in the winter time.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brush for creating volume and smooth, sleek blowouts.
Many customers highlight the lightweight, comfortable handle and grip.
Several reviewers appreciate the vegan/cruelty-free, non-boar bristle construction.
Some customers report the bristles are scratchy or fail to grip and brush through hair effectively.
A few reviewers experienced bristle shedding or burning/melting during use.
